#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

class Scanner {
public:
    Scanner() {
        in = stdin;
    }
    InputStream in;
    int k, l;
    char* bb = new char[1 << 15];
    char getc() {
        if (k >= l) {
            k = 0;
            try {
                l = fread(bb, 1, 1 << 15, in);
            } catch (...) {
                l = 0;
            }
            if (l <= 0) return EOF;
        }
        return bb[k++];
    }
    int nextInt() {
        char c = 0;
        while (c <= 32) c = getc();
        int a = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            a = a * 10 + c - '0';
            c = getc();
        }
        return a;
    }
};

Scanner sc;

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() {
        cout.rdbuf(this);
    }
    void main() {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        int* ii = new int[k];
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++)
            ii[h] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        vector<vector<int>> aa(n);
        for (int h = 0; h < m; h++) {
            int i = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            aa[i].push_back(j);
            aa[j].push_back(i);
        }
        int t = n + k + 1;
        int n_ = n * t + 1;
        int m_ = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (t - 1);
        init();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            vector<int>& adj = aa[i];
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (int j : adj) {
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++)
                        link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                int v = u + 1;
                link(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++)
            link(n_ - 1, ii[h] * t + 0, 1, 0);
        cout << edmonds_karp(n_ - 1, 0 * t + t - 1) << endl;
    }
    void init() {
        aa_ = new vector<int>[n_];
        for (int u = 0; u < n_; u++)
            aa_[u] = vector<int>();
        pi = new int[n_];
        dd = new int[n_];
        bb = new int[n_];
        qq = new int[nq];
        iq = new bool[n_];
        uu = new int[m_];
        vv = new int[m_];
        uv = new int[m_];
        cost = new int[m_];
        cc = new int[m_ * 2];
        m_ = 0;
    }
    void link(int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
        int h = m_++;
        uu[h] = u;
        vv[h] = v;
        uv[h] = u ^ v;
        cost[h] = cos;
        cc[h << 1 ^ 0] = cap;
        aa_[u].push_back(h << 1 ^ 0);
        aa_[v].push_back(h << 1 ^ 1);
    }
    void enqueue(int v) {
        if (iq[v])
            return;
        if (head + cnt == nq) {
            if (cnt * 2 <= nq)
                memcpy(qq, qq + head, cnt * sizeof(int));
            else {
                int* qq_ = new int[nq * 2];
                memcpy(qq_, qq + head, cnt * sizeof(int));
                qq = qq_;
            }
            head = 0;
        }
        qq[head + cnt++] = v;
        iq[v] = true;
    }
    int dequeue() {
        int u = qq[head++];
        cnt--;
        iq[u] = false;
        return u;
    }
    bool spfa(int s, int t) {
        memset(pi, INF, n_ * sizeof(int));
        pi[s] = 0;
        head = cnt = 0;
        enqueue(s);
        while (cnt > 0) {
            int u = dequeue();
            int d = dd[u] + 1;
            vector<int>& adj = aa_[u];
            for (int h_ : adj)
                if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                    int h = h_ >> 1;
                    int p = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? cost[h] : -cost[h]);
                    int v = u ^ uv[h];
                    if (pi[v] > p || pi[v] == p && dd[v] > d) {
                        pi[v] = p;
                        dd[v] = d;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        enqueue(v);
                    }
                }
        }
        return pi[t] != INF;
    }
    void push(int s, int t) {
        int c = INF;
        for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            c = min(c, cc[h_]);
        }
        for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            cc[h_] -= c;
            cc[h_ ^ 1] += c;
        }
    }
    void push1(int s, int t) {
        for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            cc[h_]--;
            cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
        }
    }
    int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        while (spfa(s, t))
            push1(s, t);
        int c = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++)
            c += cost[h] * cc[h << 1 ^ 1];
        return c;
    }
    vector<int>* aa_;
    int n_, m_;
    int* pi, dd, bb;
    int* uu, vv, uv, cost;
    int* cc;
private:
    int head, cnt;
    bool* iq;
    int nq = 1;
    int* qq;
};

int main() {
    CF1187G o;
    o.main();
    return 0;
}
